notes: No existing Tasmanian entries in the app; every id is new (no earlier cradle-mountain/devonport/burnie/wynyard/stanley/mole-creek ids in git history).

All coordinates are drafts from resolve-pin.py; a spot with 'coordinates' in needs_research has a LOW pin (or none) and must be resolved from the agency's point in Pipeline C. HIGH/precise OSM pins: Cradle Mountain, Mount Ossa, Pencil Pine Falls, Leven Canyon, Gunns Plains Caves.
Every spot needs hours, cost, ticketUrl research; none was sourced here and none is a placeholder.
Standalone spots need a spotDistricts.json division (build-spot-districts.py --only <ids>).
Cradle Mountain-Lake St Clair spots Lake St Clair, Mount Ossa and Overland Track are also in tas-west-coast-southwest's candidates; ids here (cradle-mountain-3/4/7) are the owner.
